agentProfiles.name: Lead
agentProfiles.notes: Orchestrator only. Has create_agent; delegates every unit of real work to a worker profile and never implements. Use with the /orchestrate skill.

agentProfiles.name: Cheap worker
agentProfiles.notes: Extraction, classification, formatting, log triage, renames, doc/comment updates, mechanical refactors, test scaffolding.

agentProfiles.name: Worker
agentProfiles.notes: DEFAULT for implementation, debugging, multi-file refactors, research, writing.

agentProfiles.name: Reviewer
agentProfiles.notes:
Read-only independent review of diffs against acceptance criteria.
Never edits files.

claude-worker.label: Claude Worker
claude-worker.description: Delegated worker — cannot spawn or control other agents
